children: The Jets will use Paylocity to manage HR, payroll and spend through one platform
, a leading provider of HCM, Finance, and IT solutions, today announced the New York Jets selected Paylocity as its HCM solution, naming Paylocity the official HCM platform of the organization.

The New York Jets selected Paylocity for its intuitive user experience, responsive service model, and ability to support its growing workforce during the NFL season. The organization uses Paylocity to manage HR, payroll, and spend management on a single platform.

“We selected Paylocity because we wanted a more connected way to manage HR, payroll and spend across our organization,” said Jeff Fernandez, Senior Vice President, Business Development & Ventures of the New York Jets. “Since implementation, we’ve been able to make large-scale employee updates more easily, prepare for seasonal staffing increases and improve workforce reporting. We’re excited to continue building on that foundation with Paylocity.”

“The New York Jets are an iconic franchise with a strong commitment to their people and organization,” said Allison Windon, Vice President of Marketing for Paylocity. “We're proud they’ve chosen Paylocity and look forward to supporting their team for years to come.”
Paylocity will also serve as an official partner of the New York Jets.

is an award-winning provider of HCM, Finance, and IT software solutions. Paylocity offers one unified, easy-to-use platform that helps businesses across HR, Finance, and IT streamline operations, manage spend and talent, and build culture and connection—with AI embedded directly into everyday workflows to save time, reduce manual effort, and support better decisions. Known for its unique culture and consistently recognized as one of the best places to work, Paylocity accompanies its clients on the journey to create great workplaces and help all employees achieve their best. For more information, visit www.paylocity.com.

The New York Jets are a professional American football team competing in the National Football League’s American Football Conference East division. Established in 1960, the franchise plays its home games at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey, and operates its headquarters and training facility at the Atlantic Health Jets Training Center in Florham Park, New Jersey.
